lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Town Council's September 1 work session, where a third-party audit of the Town's rental housing policies is up for review — a process that could shape who gets to stay in this valley for years to come. The Telluride Hospital District board also meets Thursday to weigh a Two Site Model for the new facility and possibly act on architect selection, two decisions that will define what gets built and where. Elsewhere, TMVOA is moving to formalize a Workforce Housing Committee, the county is sorting out child care funding implications, and the Open Space Commission is taking a field look at festival camping in Bear Creek Reserve.

notable.stake: Board may act on hospital's Two Site Model and architect selection process.
TMVOA votes to form Workforce Housing Committee and adopt updated policies.
Town Council reviews third-party audit of rental housing policies — central to who can afford to stay.
County weighs CCAP child care funding and its budget implications for San Miguel County.
